properties.statement: To find where a reasoning read spent its time, wrote temporary per-function wall-clock spans and evaluation counters into reflow2-core by hand (evaluations made, truths computed, readings not kept because a circle was cut, cuts), printed them from a test, then removed them. Nothing in reflow2 says what a read cost or how often it recomputed, so the stall's cause (per-call memo versus unkept readings under cuts) could only be told apart with hand instrumentation.
